text.p: Serbian police said on Friday they had arrested two local Albanians on terrorism charges in the southern province of Kosovo.

Besim Rama from the village of Prekaze and Avni Nura from Prelovac belonged to a group that killed three policeman and a civilian and wounded seven police in attacks from 1993 to mid-1996, the Interior Ministry said in a report carried by the state news agency Tanjug.
Although Kosovo is a province of Serbia, its population is 90 per cent Albanian. There have been a series of attacks on Serbian police this year but few suspects arrested.
The Democratic League of Kosovo, which represents the interests of Kosovo Albanians, has accused Serbia of systematic human rights abuses.
Police who arrested the two suspects found weapons used in the the crimes and a large quantity of other firearms, ammunition and explosives, the Interior Ministry said.
